summary: First-finish smoke test. Admin auth + dashboard + students + receipt creation + numbering + reports work end-to-end. Frontend login & Dashboard render correctly; New Receipt page shows all 9 receipt types. However a CRITICAL blocker prevents any non-admin (cashier/accountant/manager) from logging in, which blocks all RBAC / adjustment / extension / refund / cancel testing.
passed: POST /api/auth/login for admin returns JWT token + user; role=administrator
GET /api/departments returns 4 seeded depts (EP, MP, SEC, JC)
POST /api/receipts (receipt_type=school) creates receipt with number EP-2026-000001 format and increments (000001,000002,000003 observed); amount_in_words populated (e.g. 'One Thousand Rupees Only')
GET /api/dashboard returns collection_today, receipts_today_count, pending_approvals, due_today/tomorrow/overdue, recent_receipts, dept_totals_today
GET /api/reports/collection (with date_from/date_to) returns rows, gross_collection, refunds, vouchers, net, by_mode, by_type, count
Frontend: login flow works and localStorage token stored; Dashboard renders 6 KPI cards, Recent Receipts table shows the 3 created receipts
Frontend: /new-receipt renders all 9 receipt-type buttons (rtype-school/admission/bus/misc/department/general_money/refund/debit_voucher/general_collection); student search returns BC-EP-001 result

failed.issue: Cashier, Accountant, Manager cannot log in. POST /api/auth/login with email 'cashier@balaji.local' / 'accountant@balaji.local' / 'manager@balaji.local' returns HTTP 422 with pydantic EmailStr error: 'value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name that cannot be used with email.' The seeded users use the .local TLD which the email-validator library rejects.

failed.area: backend field naming vs review-request contract
failed.issue: Receipt response uses `number` and `total`; the review-request text referenced `receipt_no` and 'amount'. Frontend consistently uses `number`/`total` so UI works, but this may confuse external integrators. Not a real bug — flagging for awareness.
failed.evidence: POST /api/receipts response body has keys number='EP-2026-000003', total=1000.0 (no receipt_no/amount)

failed.issue: Student search results on New Receipt page have no data-testid on individual result rows, making automated selection difficult. Manual UI works.
failed.evidence: page.query_selector_all('[data-testid^="nr-student-result-"]') returned 0 while UI clearly shows the row BC-EP-001 Aarav Sharma

failed.issue: GET /api/reports/collection returns 422 unless both date_from and date_to are supplied. Review request implied defaults; consider defaulting to current day.

action_items: Fix non-admin login: either (a) change seeded staff emails from *.local to valid TLDs (e.g. cashier@balaji.school / cashier@balaji.co.in) and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md, OR (b) relax pydantic model to `str` / use `EmailStr` with a custom validator that skips deliverability, OR (c) install email_validator with `allow_special_use=True` equivalent. This is a HARD blocker for RBAC / adjustment / extension / refund testing.

After fix, rerun: cashier receipt create (should succeed), cashier adjustment approve (403), manager adjustment approve (200), extension create total==outstanding (200), extension total!=outstanding (400), manager approve extension -> reminders materialize, refund by cashier (403), refund by manager (200), receipt cancel by cashier (403), reprint increments reprint_count, debit voucher gets V-YYYY-nnnnnn number, cashier audit (403), cashier UI hides Administration and Fee Structure menu items.
(Optional LOW) Add data-testid="nr-student-result-<admno>" on New Receipt student search result rows to make E2E selection reliable.
(Optional LOW) Default date_from/date_to in /api/reports/collection to today when omitted.

success_rate.backend: ~80% (admin path fully green; RBAC/adjustment/extension/refund/cancel/voucher paths untestable due to login blocker)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (login, dashboard, students, new-receipt render; end-to-end receipt issuance via UI not completed due to unrelated testid gap; RBAC menu filtering untested due to login blocker)
